rapport_notes: Rep is friendly, clear-spoken, maintains good conversational tone throughout; no awkwardness or defensiveness.
process_discipline_notes: No repeats detected; rep did not explicitly hold silence after open-ended questions, but also did not interrupt or re-pitch aggressively.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Let me explain what this call will look like. Okay. I just need a few minutes to ask you a question regarding the move. And from there, I'll be able to tell you what the hourly rate will look like.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: NOT ASKED — rep moved directly into logistics probing (date, location, bedrooms, parking, items) without asking about Brenden's priorities or concerns outside of the move logistics.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Now, let's talk about the item sir. Though we're going to be moving that might require extra time and care for the move... Now the best part with this move, once you book this, you're gonna get up to $2,000 free evaluation coverage. So if anything gets damaged gets broken, gets mishandled...
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Our movers are not daily contracted workers. They're one of the best and they are professionally trained. So prior to the move you're gonna receive an email of who your movers are...
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We also have an on time guarantee. So, if the movers arrive late, say for example, for the setup in the afternoon, every time they get late, you get discount on your final bill.
evidence_quotes.communication: Prior to the move you're gonna receive an email of who your movers are helping extension of strangers arriving at your front door...
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Typically for a 1600 square foot house it usually takes two movers between six and a half to eight and a half hours to completely move sir. In your case since we're moving you from a one story house into another one story house, no boxes however but with special items such as your pallet bike your fridge your washer and dryer to take extra time... I'm estimating the move to take around eight to nine hours for two movers...
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Keep in mind sir that this is just gonna be an estimate and we only factor in little extra time in the quote based on the details that we have discussed. Because ultimately we'd much rather give you a realistic worst case number.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: On move day itself if the move goes faster than what we have anticipated, then of course, you pay less, say for example even if you're booked for four movers for four and a half, if they'll be able to finish the job in three hours, and you'll only pay for four hour, four movers for three hours...
evidence_quotes.close_failure: Alright, then congratulations Brandon, you're officially on the books. So if there is any question any clarification, please feel free to give us a call... [No rate-lock line, no explicit ask; customer had to stop rep to request quote confirmation.]

top_strength: Rep delivered a complete, well-structured estimate with clear anchor (6.5–8.5 hr range for 1600 sq ft), personalization (one-story to one-story, Peloton/fridge/W-D), and three of five Save Your Ass lines (commit to rate via hourly pricing, estimate-as-window framing, beats-it pay-less logic).
coaching_note: Stage 1 must include the agenda question ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns on this move?') asked *before* logistics probing begins — this call jumped straight into discovery logistics and never uncovered Brenden's real priorities; also, close with rate-lock line ('your rate locks when you book') and explicit ask ('shall we get you on the books?') instead of declaring him booked without confirmation.
